The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 77°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.48 Å. There is one shorter (2.32 Å) and one longer (2.41 Å) Na-F bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.93 Å. There is one shorter (2.45 Å) and one longer (2.64 Å) Na-F bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.45 Å. There is one shorter (2.41 Å) and one longer (2.50 Å) Na-F bond length. There is one shorter (2.39 Å) and one longer (2.45 Å) Na-F bond length. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms.
